instruction.text: Welcher Satz enthält den Infinitiv des Passivs? Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++The rubbish shall be thrown in the bin.
Throw the rubbish in the bin!
He threw the rubbish in the bin.
++Fish can be caught in the lake.
She can catch fish in the lake.
Catching fish in the lake is easy.
They will recycle their water bottles.
++Our friendship shouldn't be taken for granted.
I took our friendship for granted.
Don't take our friendship for granted.
++Her books might be stored on another shelf.
She will store her books on another shelf.
Her books have been stored on another shelf.
